summary: United Microelectronics Corp filed a Form 6-K on August 6, 2026, reporting routine operating updates for July 2026 per Rule 13a-16. The exhibit discloses monthly net sales of NT$23,844,045 thousand (up 18.98% YoY), year-to-date sales of NT$153,614,609 thousand (up 12.41%), no funds lent to other parties, no endorsements or guarantees, and derivative positions, including outstanding interest rate swaps with a notional of NT$903,000 thousand and realized losses of NT$35,898 thousand. The filing contains no special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, spin-off, restructuring, or management change; it is a standard periodic revenue and financial status report.
